module_summary: Computes Ethernet FCS over an AXI-Stream: per-byte LFSR CRC32 instances update a running CRC register each beat, and on tlast the inverted CRC is latched with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Stream payload fed into LFSR CRC instances.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Beat valid; enables CRC state update and FCS capture.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame: latches FCS, reinitializes CRC state.

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte keep selects which partial CRC becomes final FCS.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Tied high; module always accepts data.

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 accumulator, reset to all ones per frame.

anchors.name: crc_next
anchors.why: Next CRC values from LFSR instances per byte lane.

anchors.name: output_fcs
anchors.why: Final frame check sequence output from fcs_reg.

anchors.name: fcs_reg
anchors.why: Latches inverted CRC at frame end; drives output_fcs.

anchors.name: fcs_valid_reg
anchors.why: Registered FCS valid pulse set on tlast.

groups.name: CRC engine
groups.description: LFSR CRC32 instances updating running crc_state each valid beat.

groups.name: Frame control
groups.description: Valid/tlast/tkeep decide CRC update, reset and final lane select.

groups.name: FCS output
groups.description: Registers inverted CRC and valid pulse at frame end.
